embeds.title: 🎨 Aramaki's Theme Editor — now for Tinfoil *and* the RomM Switch client
embeds.description: Two visual editors in one page, no hand-editing raw JSON. The original **Tinfoil** editor for `theme.json`, and a new one for the **RomM Switch client** — colours, backgrounds, fonts, mascot art and music. Both run in the browser, install as apps, and ship as a Windows desktop build.

fields.name: ✨ Features
fields.value:
• **Tinfoil** — auto-generated editor, live 16:9 preview, palette generator, k-means extraction from your background
• **RomM** — 19 semantic colour roles, WCAG readability checks, live animated-background memory budget
• Browse the published theme catalog and open any theme with its assets
• Background motion previewed with the client's own arithmetic, not a lookalike
• 100% local — nothing you open ever leaves your machine
